# cdnpro_webhook (Resource)

A CDN Pro webhook, called when a deployment, purge or prefetch finishes. `credentials.secret_key` is write-only and tracked by hash. The API cannot remove credentials once set, so dropping the `credentials` block replaces the webhook. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cdnpro_webhook" "deploy_notify" {
  name = "deploy-notifications"
  url  = "https://hooks.example.com/cdn-deploy"

  credentials = {
    user       = "cdn-notifier"
    secret_key = var.webhook_secret_key # write-only, never stored in state
  }
}

resource "cdnpro_deployment" "staging" {
  target  = "staging"
  webhook = cdnpro_webhook.deploy_notify.id
  # ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `url` (String) HTTP or HTTPS endpoint that receives the POST.

### Optional

- `credentials` (Attributes) HTTP Basic credentials sent with the callback. Both fields are required together. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String)
- `id` (String) Webhook ID. Only available from the creation response, never from a later read.
- `last_call_time` (String)
- `last_update_time` (String) Also advanced by the API on every call of the webhook.
- `total_calls` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password for the callback. Never read back into state.
- `user` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The webhook ID is only returned when it is created (Location header); it is not
# in the GET response, so take it from wherever it was recorded (e.g. the portal).
terraform import cdnpro_webhook.deploy_notify 6716f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4
```
